meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 它会扫描代码库,按 9 个维度查技术债,每条发现附 file:line:col 引用、严重度和工时估算,最后在仓库根目录写出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,含 Top 5 优先级和快速修复清单。
howto.when: 当你要求做代码库健康检查、技术债审计、架构评审或清理规划时触发;提到 “tech debt”、“code health” 等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 对这个仓库做一次技术债审计
做代码库健康检查,重点看架构和错误处理
列出 30 分钟内能修完的快速修复项
say.note: 输出 Quick Wins 清单

howto.what_en: Scans the repo across 9 dimensions (architecture, consistency, types, tests, dependencies, performance, error handling, security, docs) and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with file:line:col citations, severity, effort estimates, Top 5 priorities, and a quick-wins checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, or cleanup planning, or mention keywords like "tech debt" or "code health".

say_en.text: Run a tech debt audit on this repo
Do a code health check, focus on architecture and error handling
List the quick wins fixable in under 30 minutes
